title: The Compass of the Palatinate
author: Jude Underhill
blurb: Kestrel Yarrow, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
